name: postmessage-lint
description: Finds window.postMessage/onmessage mistakes that never throw: broadcasting with '*', a message handler that never checks event.origin, an origin check that a crafted subdomain defeats, unverified event.source, and received data reaching innerHTML/eval.
author: __AUTHOR__

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:dist
